summary: v2 (make it funnier, no new GPU): J's lines and the 8 s silence unchanged. Added the Bot's deadpan as comedy: a floor chime ding right after 'We're not moving', the Bot blinks once after the 'paid to hit you' joke (cutaway before Exit Punk's no-laugh face), and after 'Was that a joke? Was that you?' its CRT types three dots, then deletes them (nothing). Tightened the no-laugh reaction and the pause after the question. Still the v1 shots; clips are soft.
caption: Stuck in an elevator with the guy who's paid to hit you. #DoseOfDestruction #ExitPunk #ShutupBot #HawkesGen hawkesgen.com

beats.line: No no no no. Hey. Hi. Hey. You're my nine o'clock.

beats.line: You know it's a good sign when the elevator dies and you're in here with the guy who's paid to hit you.

beats.method: keyframe image.edit from Exit Punk reference + elevator blockout -> video.talk (InfiniteTalk) with ElevenLabs line (k2)

beats.action: waits for a laugh that doesn't come, smile fades

beats.action: circles the tiny room trying things, hands up

beats.line: I don't mind the fighting. It's the thing before. The waiting.

beats.line: Was that a joke? Was that you? (silence)
